per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Small interactions (page loads, menu clicks) shall be perceived as instantaneous; any such interaction shall not take longer than 5 seconds to complete from the user's perspective.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'Any interface between a user and the automated system shall have a maximum response time of 5 seconds unless noted by an exception below.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The payment processing step for card-based purchases shall complete within 15 seconds.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'When purchasing a streaming movie or pre-paid card via credit card the processing time should have a maximum response time of 15 seconds.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Startup buffering for video playback shall begin playback within 10 seconds (not counting ISP-added latency).
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: When streaming a movie the buffering time should take no longer than 10 seconds (plus any latency on the user's connection.)'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Streaming playback shall use adaptive bitrate and handle high-latency and poor-network conditions to minimize stalls and keep playback smooth.

The site shall remain functional (catalogue, accounts, search, reviews, purchasing where feasible) when the streaming backend is degraded or unavailable; the UI shall display informative messaging and allow queuing of purchases or viewing receipts.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The website shall continue to operate if the streaming server goes down.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: A failure of the primary payment gateway shall not render the site unusable; the system shall accept pre-paid cards, queue transactions for retry where appropriate, and clearly inform users about payment service issues.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The website shall continue to operate if the payment gateway goes down.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Payment data (credit card details) stored on servers shall be encrypted at rest using AES-256 and keys must be managed by a dedicated key management service; tokenization shall be used so routine operations do not require decrypting primary data.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'All credit card information will be secured on the server and only accessible by authorized Izogn administrators. Information will be encrypted in the database.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Access to raw card details shall be restricted by role-based access control so that only a very small set of administrators can view decrypted card data, and all access to such data shall be audited and monitored.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'All credit card information will be secured on the server and only accessible by authorized Izogn administrators. Information will be encrypted in the database.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system shall be designed for high availability with appropriate redundancy and failover and shall target an availability metric of approximately 99.5%.
The UI and workflows shall be usable by approximately 90% of novice Internet users for common tasks without help.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product should be able to be used by 90% of novice users on the Internet.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The site shall follow web standards (semantic HTML, W3C recommendations) and use ARIA where appropriate to ensure accessibility and maintainability.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The website will comply with W3C standards.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Privacy practices and the privacy policy shall be visible to users before personal data is collected and be easily findable from every page.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The website shall make its user aware of its information practices before collection data from them via a Privacy Policy accessible on all pages of the website.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Admin UI shall enable operators to manage catalogue, customer accounts, pre-paid cards, and analytics without touching production code, and all admin actions shall respect role-based access controls.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'All credit card information will be secured on the server and only accessible by authorized Izogn administrators. Information will be encrypted in the database.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: Reviews shall be tied to purchase or viewing history to reduce fake reviews, and the system shall support moderation and admin removal of abusive content.

The UI/UX shall be optimized for low-bandwidth and limited-data users by defaulting to lower-bitrate previews, using clear typography and patterns that read well under poor connections, and providing obvious controls to switch quality.
System observability and maintainability shall be implemented: instrument key services, provide health checks, and enable safe rollbacks and predictable graceful degradation when subsystems fail.
